courses.title: Elven Codes and Faerie Light (Light Language audio)
courses.description: A short Light Language transmission set to music, about five to ten minutes long, which Jamye Price offers as a way to connect with nature and with joy through what she calls elven and faerie energies. Sold as a download or on CD.

courses.title: Sacred Relationship (Light Language audio)
courses.description: A recording by Jamye Price with a 20-minute Light Language transmission and a 20-minute channelled guided meditation in English. It centres on balancing the inner masculine and feminine and on letting go of old hurts that stand in the way of balanced relationships.
